verdict.rationale: Measuring model performance and running shadow trials is a fair question for a fraud-decisioning product, but the evidence pack shows no precision/recall reporting on merchant traffic and no shadow-mode or champion/challenger testing of models or rules. The documented TEST/sandbox environment exists only to verify the integration before production, which is integration testing, not live shadow evaluation of decisions. The reporting mention for agentic orders covers traffic reporting, not model accuracy metrics.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can measure the model itself — precision and recall on my traffic, shadow-mode trials of new models or rules before they take over decisions
